newsitem.title: UK: NWE sweet straight-run fuel oil weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE sweet straight-run fuel oil weaker.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil cargoes were weaker on Tuesday despite a stonger crude market, traders said.
Many thought recent high levels were unsustainable, and valued these cargoes at $142 fob NWE.
High sulphur cargoes were better supported, and saw a M100 cargo trade at mean of means +$5.50 cif Flushing.
